title: VIP and Non-VIP Corporate User Exclusive: Binance Upgrades USD Bank Transfer Solutions to Enable 1:1 USD to Stablecoin On- and Off-Ramp
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is thrilled to announce that we are upgrading our USD solution to enable 1 USD: 1 XUSD on/off-ramp with zero spread. VIP and Non-VIP corporate (KYB) users in select jurisdictions may now access this solution to  buy and sell XUSD, USDT and USDC with USD via SWIFT Bank Transfer . Key Benefits With This Upgrade: 1:1 Exchange Rate : No spread on USD to XUSD , from $1 to $10M. Wide Stablecoin Access:  Simpler access to buy and sell XUSD, USDT and USDC. Bank-Level Security : USD transfer capabilities through trusted top-tier banking partners. Seamless Transfers : Reliable and Fast SWIFT integration for both buy and sell. Buy XUSD Now Notes:  Users are required to  complete KYB account verification . This service may be gradually rolled out to more regions. We will continue to provide more updates as we expand this service.  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information:  How to Buy Crypto with USD via SWIFT Bank Transfer  for Corporate Account How to Sell Crypto to USD via  SWIFT Bank Transfer   (Corporate Account) Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-06-09
